research_note: Selected for this session after checking primary source pages. Connections are editorial judgments, not speaker endorsements. Books, papers, and recordings were not reviewed in full; listing checks and access limits are noted below. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: -Znext-solver: what, why, and when
resources.why: Read the earlier motivation and design challenges behind the new trait solver.
resources.caveat: Official session description checked; no recording is linked here.

resources.title: Enabling the next-generation trait solver on nightly
resources.why: Connect the solver redesign to inference changes, compatibility tests, and future language work.
resources.caveat: A dated nightly rollout report; planned stabilization is not a stable-release guarantee.

resources.title: Next-gen trait solving
resources.why: Learn how goals, candidates, and constraints turn trait bounds into compiler decisions.

resources.title: Diving Deep: implied bounds and variance
resources.why: Work through a concrete soundness problem involving lifetime bounds and variance.
resources.caveat: Historical analysis with an author correction; check the linked issue for current status.

resources.title: RustBelt: Securing the Foundations of the Rust Programming Language
resources.why: Explore formal foundations behind Rust’s safety argument through the paper, presentation, and linked proof artifact.
resources.caveat: POPL 2018; abstract and asset listing reviewed, not proofs or executable artifact.

resources.title: GhostCell: Separating Permissions from Data in Rust
resources.why: Explore a research design that separates permission from data when reasoning about shared mutable structures.
resources.caveat: ICFP 2021; abstract and asset listing reviewed; results not reproduced.

resources.title: Verus publications and projects
resources.why: Find work on Rust verification and distinguish a tool’s proved properties from guarantees supplied by Rust’s type system.
resources.caveat: Publication index reviewed; each paper and tool needs separate evaluation.

resources.title: AutoVerus: Automated Proof Generation for Rust Code
resources.why: Explore LLM-assisted proof construction with verification feedback, beyond the properties checked by ordinary Rust types.
resources.caveat: OOPSLA 2025, arXiv revision 22 August 2025; abstract and introduction reviewed. Reported results are bounded to the paper's benchmark and were not reproduced here.

resources.title: VerusBelt: A Semantic Foundation for Verus’s Proof-Oriented Extensions to the Rust Type System
resources.why: Read research on the semantic foundations of Verus’s proof-oriented types, borrowing, and concurrency.
resources.caveat: PLDI 2026; abstract and introduction reviewed. The paper studies a subset and does not verify the Verus implementation or all Rust libraries.
